summary: SR Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing authorization of its third stock repurchase program for up to 10% of outstanding shares (801,320 shares), to commence after completing its second program (22,176 shares remaining). Repurchases may occur via open market or private transactions, block trades, or 10b5-1 plans, with no fixed timeline or obligation. The program reflects ongoing capital return following the September 2023 mutual-to-stock conversion. Watch for pace of buybacks and impact on share count; no premium or break fee applies as this is an open-market authorization.
